title: Choose the visual world for web 2.0
question: The roll assigned the Swatch Deck. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Swatch Deck
options.lineage: paint-chip fan decks and colour-matching cards
options.thesis: Every list owns a hue from the deck, and the whole shell takes its colour when you open it.
options.viewport: Sidebar of hue chips, the open list floods rail and ground with its colour, cards and detail panel in the same hue family.
options.risk: Loud if many lists open at once; hues must stay AA in both themes.

raised.raise: A strict cell grid: cards, tiles and the detail panel snap to one visible-feeling module.
Colour fields carry meaning and controls are capsules with one overshooting 0.4s motion.

options.label: Braun Catalogue
options.thesis: A quiet product shelf in warm grey where the images are the only colour and one orange does every action.
options.viewport: Light-grey shell, square-cornered cards, orange only on the primary actions and live pen fields.
options.risk: The most familiar direction in this category; it can read as generic if the images are weak.

options.label: Zoo Guide Map
options.lineage: summer zoo and gardens guide maps
options.thesis: Flat colour lobes and yellow capsules make a playful, image-forward shared scrapbook.
options.viewport: Green rail, cream ground, capsule controls, big rounded cards.
options.case: Holds product clarity for browsing as a pair; loses on dense lists and calm for long sessions.
options.risk: Can feel childish on a movie or camera list.

options.label: Newsprint Catalog
options.thesis: Dense stamp-size thumbnails on newsprint, with the item you care about circled in red pen.
options.viewport: Packed square thumbnail grid, ink-black rows, one red pen mark for the selection.
options.case: Great for scanning hundreds of images; weaker for the calm, personal feel.
options.risk: Too dense for phone and for 8-item lists.

options.label: Datamatics
options.case: Loses both axes: strobing black-and-white is the opposite of calm and image-forward.

options.label: Crouwel Grid
options.case: Letterform building is poster work, not a collection browser.

options.label: Acetate Manual
options.case: Reads as documentation, and two-ply layers fight images.

options.label: Metro Tiles
options.case: Chrome-less type interface hides the in-place editing affordances.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean white collection app: sidebar, card grid, detail panel, one blue accent.
canonCard.viewport: White shell, blue primary buttons, neutral cards.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
